name: AmberOne API
tagline: Turn any website into build-ready mobile and desktop app projects.
shortDescription: Submit a URL, get back a build-ready Android, iOS, PWA, Electron or Capacitor project. Your signing keys never leave your machine.
longDescription:
Submit a URL. The AmberOne API scans it for wrap compatibility, applies the fixes it safely can to the
generated package, and returns a downloadable project you build yourself.

**What you get is a project, not a compiled app.** Android and iOS outputs are Capacitor
projects ready for `gradlew assembleRelease` or Xcode's Archive — which also means your signing
keys never leave your machine. Nothing is compiled, signed, installed, or submitted on your behalf.

Every response uses the same envelope: `{ ok: true, data, requestId }` or
`{ ok: false, error: { code, message }, requestId }`. Branch on `ok`; match on `error.code`,
which is stable. Quote `requestId` in any support request.
sandbox: Keys prefixed wrap_test_ run the full pipeline and are never billed.

pricingNote: This API is a feature of the AmberOne subscription, not a separate SKU. Buyers subscribe to AmberOne Starter ($79/mo, 10 wraps) or Growth ($249/mo, 50 wraps); Enterprise is unlimited and negotiated. Those are the platform's own prices from src/lib/pricing.ts. The standalone tiers carry `sellable: false` and exist only for marketplaces that require a per-API price — nothing subscribes to them. Competitive anchors for the bundled allowance: Median.co ~$490/yr self-serve to $18k+ enterprise; WebViewGold one-time per app per platform; Adalo-class $60 and $249/mo; outsourced PWA build ~$2,000. Those are managed services — this API returns a project and stops, so it prices below them.
